title: ToxiLab: How Well Do Open-Source LLMs Generate Synthetic Toxicity Data?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of a 'Hate Speech' dataset by prompting open-source LLMs to generate synthetic toxic data targeting groups based on race or ethnicity, then measuring generation success rates, human quality assessment, and downstream MLP classifier performance.
